The joins are inverted. The start (info_player_start 22) sits at the pump house's east door, and the only way out (trigger_changelevel) is in the gatehouse. The sky is clear blue in the start view and the yaw 90 and 180 views, which reads as daylight, not the brief's dusk. The bright and dark areas do not match a dusk yard.

P7.reason: A yellow and black hazard-striped trim runs along the base of the walls in the start and yaw -90 views, which is a brief detail. The brief's drums (a 55-gallon drum with a hazard stripe) and the broken truck-sized pipe section are not visible in any view.
